content.title: 2023 Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation
content.focus: Diagnosis and management of atrial fibrillation, with discussions on hyperthyroidism, and pulmonary disease.

sections.title: 10.11 Hyperthyroidism
content: Comparative thromboembolic risk in atrial fibrillation with or without a secondary precipitant.

sections.title: 10.12 Pulmonary Disease
content: Beta-blockers reduced the risk of mortality and exacerbation in patients with COPD.
